name: TrueReview
summary: Review management for local businesses: SMS and email review requests, Google review monitoring and replies, AI response suggestions and multi-location plans.
best_for: local businesses that want to send review requests by SMS and email, watch their Google reviews and answer them from one dashboard, with up to five locations on one Premium plan
skip_if: most of your customers are outside the US and Canada and you need SMS requests; or you run many locations and the monthly per-location add-ons on top of Premium outgrow your budget
honest_knock: The yearly discount is steep but the terms make every payment non-refundable, and the trial needs a credit card. Starter is a single user with five AI reply suggestions a month, unused requests expire each month, and SMS works only in the US and Canada after verification.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on truereview.co/pricing with the Monthly and Yearly toggles, and on its help-centre price list for request add-ons) TrueReview has three plans. Starter is $49 a month, or $29 a month on a yearly plan ($348 a year); Small Business $99, or $59 yearly ($708); Premium $299, or $179 yearly ($2,148). The base plan cards show a dollar sign without a currency code; the add-on price list is labelled USD. Premium includes five locations; more are sold per location per month, $39 each for the first ten extra, then $35, $32 and $29 from the 31st, and add-on locations are billed monthly even when the plan is yearly. Extra review requests are sold as recurring packs, from $12 a month for 100 to $600 a month for 10,000; one-time purchases are billed at the default price without those discounts. The free trial lasts 14 days with up to 250 SMS and email requests, and the terms say all accounts require a valid credit card. Monthly and annual payments are non-refundable under the terms, and you must cancel at least 24 hours before renewal.

schema_offer.description: Starter, billed monthly; $29 a month billed yearly ($348 a year); Small Business $99 a month or $59 billed yearly ($708); Premium $299 a month or $179 billed yearly ($2,148) with 5 locations included; extra Premium locations $39 to $29 a month each, billed monthly; the base plan cards show $ without a currency code. compare_with.name: NiceJob
compare_with.why: NiceJob is in our dossiers too and covers the same job of asking customers for reviews: when we read it on 13 October 2026 Starter was $75 a month and Pro $125. TrueReview starts lower, $49 a month or $29 on a yearly plan, but meters its plans in review requests (250 on Starter). Compare what your monthly request volume costs on each, not the entry price.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested TrueReview in the 14-day Starter trial that we started with our card. The request series and e-mail template can be set up without Google, but the SMS step is not available on the plan, although the dossier counts SMS in the trial. Without a connected review site there are no reviews or reports. Cancelling in the trial ended it at once after a 50% off offer and a password step. Account and start: we created the account on the Starter plan, a 14-day trial billed monthly, with his own card; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from about 13:05 to 13:23. The interface was in English. The dashboard said You're in a trial, showed REQUEST USAGE 0 / 250* and TOTAL REVIEWS 0, and asked to connect review websites. Google was not connected. Core action, a review request without sending: the request series Campaign 01 starts with an SMS step, then e-mail steps with waits of 2, 3 and 5 days. The SMS step said SMS review requests are not supported in your current plan and was switched off. The e-mail template subject was edited to end in (test edit) and saved; the preview changed at once. E-mail goes out from a TrueReview no-reply address; an own sending domain needs a higher plan, and custom attributes are not supported on the plan. A test contact with an example address was created (Contact successfully created); no request was sent and Create Request was not clicked. Without a connected Google page the template, contacts, QR code and landing page work, but reviews, review reports and widgets have no data, and the review link has nowhere to send a customer. Plans: Billing showed Starter Base $49/month, Renews on Dec 03, 2026, an upcoming charge of $49 on Dec 03, and Keep sending after my limit switched off (extra requests are billed automatically). Removing Powered by TrueReview goes through sales. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Billing, Danger Zone, which warns that cancelling in the trial ends it immediately and you lose access, then Continue to Cancellation; a page with help options (chat, demo, articles) and No thanks, I'd like to cancel; a ONE-TIME ONLY OFFER of 50% off for 3 months, declined; a warning that the trial ends right away, the dedicated number is released and campaigns and links stop working; a reason screen (Other, Just testing); and the account password with Cancel subscription. We confirmed the password step himself. Afterwards Plan & Billing showed the card form for a new trial (Due today: $0), so no subscription is active and the $49 charge on 3 December is gone. The trial stopped at once rather than at day 14. A chat message said If you cancel now, your 14-day free trial will be forfeited. Not tested: a Google connection, sending a request, SMS, inviting teammates, more locations, Premium, buying extra requests and whether the template edit survives a reload. Clean up: the account, the test contact and the edited subject stay. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: SMS requests are not on the Starter plan in the trial. Without a connected Google page the review link has nowhere to send a customer. Cancelling during the trial ends access at once instead of at day 14, and the last step asks for the account password.
